cues: Burnt in air it gives white zinc oxide smoke, philosopher's wool.
Hot concentrated sulphuric acid gives sulphur dioxide, and very dilute nitric acid is reduced all the way to ammonium nitrate.
Zinc at minus zero point seven six volts displaces most metals.
And in alkali it reduces nitrate to ammonia, a test for nitrate.
